column8: Today's counter refuses this rep, but it says "Knees off the floor", not "Hips off the floor". When it was recorded, it counted. Since commit 0aa69f5 (2 Oct) two rules from that commit refuse it. The first: the counter no longer reads a knee the model places on the ankle (the trousers), and without those readings the legs on the push read 0.37 over the hands instead of 0.48, under the 0.41 line; that rule comes first, so its words are the ones said. The second would refuse it on its own: half-way up the push the hips had risen only 0.68 as far as the shoulders (honest reps 0.92-1.06, line 0.90). That rule says "Keep your body straight", because the same reading catches cobras: in this very sitting your floor and cobra reps read the same, 0.63-0.72. No rule says "Hips off the floor" yet. Telling hips resting on the floor apart from a cobra or a deep honest bottom would need a check that looks at the picture of the hips, and none exists: it is planned but deferred, it needs labelled recordings from several people, and using video to train it waits on a decision. Until then this rep stays refused in the wrong words; your choice of words is recorded.
